name: Normalized Bots
teaser: Makes bots a little bit more fair by changing their health and character skills. (Each option can be enabled/disabled in the option)
description_html:
THIS (AND MY OTHER MODS) WILL NOT GET UPDATED ANYMORE ON ACCOUNT ME (JustNU) LEAVING THE SPT-AKI COMMUNITY

ALL OF MY MODS ARE UNLICENCE AKA PUBLIC DOMAIN, SO ANYONE WHO WISHES TO UPDATE/IMPROVE/TAKE OVER THE DEVELOPMENT IS FREE TO DO SO

I HAVE ALSO UPDATED SOURCE ENTRY FOR EVERY MOD OF MINE, IN CASE YOU WANT THE GITHUB REPOS

Features (Every option is toggable in the config):
- in depth configuration system that allows to change all of mod’s options PER BOT
- Health changes, by default set to default player health
- Give bosses that had no armor protection some of it (Reshala, Sanitar, Cultist Priest).
- Removes OP skills from all of the bots (such as instant reloads and infinite stamina).

SHOULD WORK WITH MOST MODS THAT CHANGE BOTS.
